title: Rory and the Mossy Lanterns
verses:
The sun dipped away as the shadows grew long,
And Rory walked slow through the quiet green glade.
The crickets were starting their evening-time song,
While dusk gathered cool in the soft leafy shade.

Above in the branches, Nia whistled a call,
To show all her friends where the glow-moss was bright.
And Benny walked soft by the sparkling fall,
While Tilly stepped in with a sigh of delight.

Then Ricky dashed up with a hop and a bound,
With Psittaco tucked in the leaves on his head.
They marvelled at all of the magic they found,
Where tiny green lanterns of light had been spread.

So Rory crouched low in a nest made of moss,
And yawned as the stars started shining above.
The wind whispered soft as it drifted across,
And wrapped all the dreamers in comfort and love.

Then Benny lay down like a mountain of peace,
While Tilly curled close with a gentle deep sigh.
The rustle of branches began to decrease,
Underneath the blue glow of the shimmering sky.

Now Psittaco slumbered in Nia’s warm wing,
And Ricky was dreaming of running all day.
While Rory smiled softly to hear the night sing,
And drifted off slow as he floated away.
